XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sudden shift of the gearbox into neutral, letter "N" in the multifunction display
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: GEARBOX | ROBOTISED | FAILED | ENGAGEMENT | GEARS | NEUTRAL | NEUTRAL | P2914 | P060A |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: models with robotised gearbox

  • System: gearbox

  • Device: robotised gearbox hydraulic unit

  • Fault: The gearbox suddenly shifts into neutral while driving, the symbol "N" appears in the multifunction display, accompanied by the red warning light for gearbox faults coming on

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P2914

  • Cause: defective robotised gearbox hydraulic unit

• Intervention: replacement of the hydraulic unit of the robotised gearbox

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The hydraulic unit is located above the gearbox; the estimated time required for the repair is approximately 3 hours.
